assertions.name: fork_resolved_naive_rate_overshoots
assertions.source: lw ratio grows super-exp (1.34→3.10) vs depth-2 → λ₊≈2.184 constant (split at n≥5 ⇒ lw is the true prolongation, τ the n≤4 fit); the naive single-branch (n−½)/R overshoots the true lw ratio 2.6× at n=8 ⇒ the exact geometric rate is the full 6-branch-point residue sum, not the nearest point.

description: Lever-1 (z2bn): quantitative refinement of the SW-period↔lw fork, mpmath-only. Reproduces the fork resolution in-container (lw ratio grows 1.34→3.10 super-exp; depth-2 → λ₊≈2.18 constant; split at n≥5 ⇒ lw/#1765 is the true prolongation, τ-recurrence the n≤4 fit). NEW: the naive single-branch rate (n−½)/R overshoots the true lw ratio ~2.5× at n=8 (color cubic has 6 branch points in 3 pairs; exact rate = full multi-branch residue sum, not nearest point). lw tracks the involution-class ~√n (q→1 telephone limit). Sharpens the open piece to the exact super-exp a_D^(n) kernel (q-Bessel-class), τ being its n≤4 shadow. Anti-fit: lw categorical, branch points geometric, overshoot reported not tuned. Scope-(a), no wiring.
